::: {#news-all}
:::

```{=html}
  <p class="small muted" style="margin-top:18px">Adding news, an award or press coverage? One entry in <code>data/news.yml</code>.</p>
</section>
<script>
(function () {
  const chips = document.querySelectorAll('#newschips .chip');
  function apply(c) {
    chips.forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x.dataset.c === c));
    document.querySelectorAll('.newsfeed .list-row').forEach(r => r.style.display = (c === 'all' || r.dataset.type.split(' ').includes(c)) ? '' : 'none');
    document.querySelectorAll('.newsfeed .year').forEach(y => {
      let el = y.nextElementSibling, any = false;
      while (el && !el.classList.contains('year')) { if (el.style.display !== 'none') any = true; el = el.nextElementSibling; }
      y.style.display = any ? '' : 'none';
    });
  }
  chips.forEach(c => c.onclick = () => { apply(c.dataset.c); history.replaceState(null, '', c.dataset.c === 'all' ? 'news.html' : 'news.html?type=' + c.dataset.c); });
  const t = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('type');
  if (t && [...chips].some(c => c.dataset.c === t)) apply(t);
})();
</script>
```

:::
